2607.14264.title: MonteRET: AI Agent Enhancing Multimodal LLMs with Multi-granularity Knowledge Retrieval for Chest CT Report Generation
2607.14264.paper_summary: Automated chest CT report generation remains challenging because clinically faithful reporting requires both whole-volume understanding and accurate description of localized anatomical findings. Here we developed and retrospectively evaluated MonteRET, a region-aware retrieval-enhanced framework for generating chest CT findings sections. MonteRET integrates global CT features with region-level anatomical representations, retrieves clinically relevant knowledge using predicted medical conditions and region-level vision-language alignment, and refines initial reports through a knowledge-guided report rewriting agent. We trained our model on a public cohort with 24,128 CT scans from RadGenome-ChestCT. We evaluated MonteRET on the public RadGenome-ChestCT test set of 1,564 CT scans and an external cohort of 82 CT scans from NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center. MonteRET improved report quality, semantic similarity, and clinical efficacy compared with a matched baseline and several state-of-the-art methods. Gains were most pronounced for recall, suggesting fewer omitted findings. Human expert evaluation by radiology residents also favored MonteRET.
2607.14264.paper_summary_zh: 自動化胸部CT報告生成仍然具有挑戰性，因為臨床上忠實的報告需要對整個體積的理解以及對局部解剖發現的準確描述。<lb/>在這裡，我們開發並回顧性評估了MonteRET，一個區域感知的檢索增強框架，用於生成胸部CT發現部分。<lb/>MonteRET將全球CT特徵與區域級解剖表示相結合，利用預測的醫療條件和區域級視覺-語言對齊檢索臨床相關知識，並通過知識引導的報告重寫代理來完善初始報告。<lb/>我們在RadGenome-ChestCT的公共隊列上訓練了我們的模型，該隊列包含24,128個CT掃描。<lb/>我們在公共RadGenome-ChestCT測試集的1,564個CT掃描和來自NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center的82個CT掃描的外部隊列上評估了MonteRET。<lb/>與匹配的基線和幾種最先進的方法相比，MonteRET提高了報告質量、語義相似性和臨床有效性。<lb/>增益在召回率上最為明顯，這表明漏報的發現較少。<lb/>放射科住院醫師的人類專家評估也偏向於MonteRET。
